title: Rui Costa Pimenta Proposes Expanding Labor Rights and Healthcare Funding
seoTitle: Rui Costa Pimenta: More Labor Rights and Health Funds
subtitle: PCO presidential candidate unveils 15-point platform covering the labor market and healthcare
excerpt: PCO presidential candidate Rui Costa Pimenta proposes expanding labor rights and boosting healthcare funding as part of a 15-point platform.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Rui Costa Pimenta, presidential candidate for the Workers' Cause Party (PCO), has released a platform encompassing 15 key areas. The proposals address issues such as the labor market, agrarian reform, housing, and healthcare.

On labor policy, the candidate outlines an intention to expand workers' rights, though the summary does not specify the exact measures to be implemented. In healthcare, the platform calls for increased sector funding, underscoring the issue as a top campaign priority.

These proposals are part of a broader agenda intended to offer voters alternatives on the country's core social and economic challenges, reflecting the candidate's platform for the presidency.

With information from Agência Brasil.
